company_notes:
Short notes from calls + internal. Trial run on Hosted API has been productive. Two main workloads: (1) support-agent (high QPS, short completions) and (2) recommendations / reranking (lower QPS but high token completions for explanation). Team quote: "We like the latency and dev DX — want predictable cost and isolation for customer data." Key asks: Dedicated capacity sizing, deterministic concurrency, and routing/fallback strategy if capacity spiky. POC highlights: avg latency ~120ms p50 for small-7b variant, p95 ~420ms during bursts; embeddings used for doc-search with daily reindex job. Finance sensitivity: wants 6–12 month commit with uplift if SLAs met. Security: must support SSO/SAML + KMS for keys and audit logs retained for 12 months. Tech notes: token mix exported (see Drive), prefer public cloud Dedicated in us-east and optional VPC peering. Action items: SE to run three sizing scenarios (conservative / expected / peak) using actual token mix and concurrency measured; AE to include ARR tiers and breakpoints for committed SKUs. POC doc: /drive/pocs/emberglow-hosted-usage-export-2026-03-01.csv.
Shorthand CRM: follow-up workshop w/ infra on 2026-03-18; procurement timeline pushed to mid-April pending finance.
token_mix_estimate: Traffic: 70% short completions (avg response 40-120 tokens), 20% medium (150-400 tokens), 10% long explanations (500-1,200 tokens). Prompts avg ~60 tokens. Overall token ratio prompt:completion ~1:3 on average.
qps_concurrency_requirements: Current Hosted pilot measured peak 32 QPS, typical working set concurrency 40 concurrent requests; engineering expects growth to 120 QPS over 6 months without optimization. Target Dedicated concurrency headroom: 3x baseline -> plan for 120 concurrent requests with autoscale burst to 250 concurrency.
forecast_qps_6mo: Baseline today: 6 QPS off-peak, 32 QPS peak. Forecasted growth (product launches + onboarding): month1 40 QPS peak, month3 70 QPS, month6 120 QPS peak. Request: recommend Dedicated capacity for 100 QPS sustained with burst to 250 QPS to meet 99th percentile traffic.
